written.title: GTA 6 Dog Poop Gameplay Premieres in the Latest Episode of South Park
written.description: What IGN, Eurogamer, Polygon and VGC reported about Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos on 28 October 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## IGN, 28 October 2026

['They Can Smell Fake Appreciation' — GTA 5 Cast Urge Jason and Lucia’s Actors to Be Grateful to Fans Before GTA 6 Launches Them to Fame](https://www.ign.com/articles/appreciate-the-fans-gta-5-cast-tell-jason-and-lucias-actors-the-most-important-things-they-should-know-before-gta-6-launches-them-to-fame)

The outlet's own summary:

> The stars behind GTA 5’s Franklin, Michael, and Trevor, along with the voice of CJ from San Andreas, were asked if they had any advice for the actors playing GTA 6’s Jason and Lucia now that the game is almost here.

> Players will even get a chance to eat at one of the game’s fast food joints , Burger Shot, at the Kaseya Center while they watch the two teams face off on the court.

> Knowing just how passionate Rockstar’s fanbase can be, actors who starred in previous games in the franchise shared their words of wisdom with the as-yet unannounced actors who are playing Jason and Lucia, the dual protagonists of GTA 6, in an interview with All Out Gaming at MCM Comic Con.

> Thus far, the actors who play Jason and Lucia have not been officially announced, though fans are extremely convinced that they’ve discovered the gal who lent her facial features to Jason’s partner in crime.

> Rockstar is ramping up marketing for the title in a major way with a Vice City-themed takeover of Miami that includes massive signs advertising the fictional city, even partnering with the Miami Heat to give the team some Vice City uniforms for their November 18 game against the Milwaukee Bucks.

## Eurogamer, 29 October 2026

[Anti-social behaviour, dog poo, and Jason: We just got a bit of new Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay, and it comes from the latest episode of South Park](https://www.eurogamer.net/dog-poo-anti-social-behaviour-and-jason-our-latest-look-at-gta-6-gameplay-comes-from-the-latest-episode-of-south-park)

The outlet's own summary:

> Our latest look at GTA 6 comes from a new episode of South Park, and it's as crass as you'd expect.

> But it seems the reach of Rockstar's marketing arm has no limit, as brand new gameplay footage cropped up in a quite unexpected place last night: the latest episode of South Park.

> Dog poo, anti-social behaviour, and Jason: Our latest look at GTA 6 gameplay comes from an episode of South Park Life's a beach.

## IGN, 29 October 2026

[GTA 6 Dog Poop Gameplay Premieres in the Latest Episode of South Park](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-dog-poop-gameplay-premieres-in-the-latest-episode-of-south-park)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 made a surprise appearance on South Park with just shy of 20 seconds of genuine, exclusive gameplay that showcased dog poop.

> We see Jason attack the NPC with the dog poo, which explodes in their face.

> In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023 View 13 Images With GTA 6’s November 19 release date just weeks away, Rockstar’s marketing has ramped up considerably.

## Polygon, 29 October 2026

[New GTA 6 Gameplay Was Shown on South Park, and It Totally Stinks](https://www.polygon.com/gta-6-dog-poop-gameplay-south-park/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Poop physics!

> Co-protagonists Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval walk behind the dog and its owner. “You can throw things at the person with dog poop,” the woman explains, as the clip shows Jason doing just that.

> The owner drops the dog feces he’s carrying, allowing Jason to pick up the mess and then attack the owner with it.

> GTA 6 characters Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval Rockstar Games We doubt picking up poop will be the only silly detail GTA 6 has.

## VGC, 29 October 2026

[The latest episode of South Park features exclusive GTA 6 footage where a man is hit in the head with dog poo | VGC](https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/the-latest-episode-of-south-park-features-exclusive-gta-6-footage-where-a-man-is-hit-in-the-head-with-dog-poo/)

The outlet's own summary:

> The episode aired on Wednesday in the US…

> The TV shows footage of Grand Theft Auto 6 – presumably provided to South Park’s creators by Rockstar – and features a gameplay sequence where protagonist Jason is on the beach , and sees a dog owner letting their dog poo on the sand, before picking it up with a bag.

> Jason throws an object at the dog owner, starting a fight, during which Jason picks up the bag of dog poo and slaps it across the man’s head.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
